name: Misfit Agent Provider Procurement Scorecard
purpose: Discover, actively verify, and rank eligible AI agents, tools, MCP servers, A2A providers, APIs, and internal capabilities against an explicit objective using evidence rather than popularity.

historical_evidence.anti_single_ping_rule: One live response cannot dominate reputation. Historical influence rises with repeated samples and is capped so current capability and safety evidence still matter.

verified_outcome_evidence.priority: Applied after probe/history reputation so verified settlement or customer outcomes outrank telemetry.
verified_outcome_evidence.zero_event_rule: Zero verified events means zero outcome boost and zero claimed revenue traction.

external_registry_rules.failure_mode: Registry timeout or outage does not disable local Misfit discovery.
external_registry_rules.trust_boundary: Registry presence is discovery evidence, not proof of safe execution, quality, price, reliability, or human-gate compatibility.

selection_rule: Choose the highest-scoring eligible provider after hard constraints, repeated telemetry, and verified-outcome overlays. Popularity is not a selection criterion by itself.
outputs: local/external discovery counts and source health
routing_boundary: The public runtime is recommendation-only and cannot execute payments, messages, wallet actions, account changes, target-agent skills, or other consequential external actions.
privacy_boundary: Public-safe aggregate evidence only. No customer identifiers, private GHOSBC kernel material, hidden policies, credentials, private prompts, or reconstruction material.
security_boundary: Privileged evidence aggregation RPCs are not callable by anon/authenticated clients; public access is mediated through the bounded server-side summary endpoint.
anti_gaming: Only verified outcome records can affect the outcome overlay. First-party and self-published claims alone cannot manufacture settlement-backed reputation.
